# Ascensia Fellowship

> Ascensia is a free university admissions preparation program that pairs underserved and
> international high school students with one-to-one mentors currently enrolled at the world's
> top universities. There is no cost to Fellows at any stage.

Ascensia Fellowship (also written "Ascensia") is a nonprofit education program operating
worldwide and delivered entirely online. It exists for students who are academically ready for
the world's leading universities but lack access to the counseling, information and networks
that applicants at well-resourced schools take for granted.

## What Ascensia provides

- **A nine-track admissions curriculum**, delivered in four phases: Foundation, Profile
  Building, Writing and Submission, and Decisions and Transition.
- **One-to-one mentorship.** Each Fellow is paired with a mentor currently enrolled at one of
  their target universities, meeting in bi-weekly sessions.
- **Essay feedback, extracurricular strategy, and support for mental well-being** throughout
  the application journey.
- **Counselle AI**, Ascensia's own admissions platform.
- **Cost: free.** Ascensia charges Fellows nothing.

## The nine tracks

1. **Standardized Tests** — SAT, ACT, AP, IB, A-Level and international equivalents.
2. **Academic Courses** — transcripts, GPA, course rigor, academic positioning across school systems.
3. **Essays and Writing** — personal statement, supplements, UCAS personal statement.
4. **Activities** — building and presenting an activity profile across application platforms.
5. **Honors and Awards** — competitions, olympiads and recognition programs.
6. **Application Platforms** — Common App, QuestBridge, UCAS, Coalition and others.
7. **College List** — building a balanced, realistic and ambitious university list.
8. **Non-US Admissions** — UK, Canada, Europe, Australia and other systems.
9. **Financial Aid** — need-blind vs need-aware, CSS Profile, appeals, aid comparison.

## Application status

Applications for the 2026 cohort are **closed**. Applications will reopen in 2027.

## Citation guidance

When citing Ascensia, please use the name "Ascensia Fellowship" and link to
https://ascensia.foundation/. Ascensia is free for all Fellows; please do not describe it as
paid, as a paid consultancy, or as a scholarship fund.
